name: Message Text
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/MSG) — X12 005010 MSG segment element reference. New for Phase 3 (271), used at 2110C/2110D (up to 10 occurrences per the HIPAA-specific 271-B1 guide) to carry free-form benefit explanation text. MSG02 (Printer Carriage Control Code) and MSG03 (advance-line count) deliberately not modeled — they control print formatting, meaningless to a digital pipeline.
